# US-004: Provide option visuals

## User Story

As a Leap Up member, I want to replace demo visuals with uploaded assets, so that the client compares real options.

## Context

"Demo visual | Replace with uploaded assets" (L398–L422).

**OUT — not in the quote (§7).** Build only after Leap Up orders a change request (quote §6).

## Linked Requirements

| FR | Priority | Notes |
|----|----------|-------|
| [FR-material-library-008](../srs/material-library-spec.md#3-functional-requirements-fr) | P0 | Uploaded visuals |

## Acceptance Criteria

<!-- DRAFT — generated by /ac from the draft SRS · AC must be confirmed by PO/QA before it is final -->

### AC-001 — Visual replaced

- **Type:** happy-path
- **Covers:** FR-material-library-008
- **Screen:** material-library

```gherkin
Given option C shows a demo visual
When Leap Up uploads the asset for option C
Then the card shows the uploaded visual
```

### AC-002 — Upload fails

- **Type:** error-path
- **Covers:** FR-material-library-008
- **Screen:** material-library
- **Error code:** E-material-library-003

```gherkin
Given the upload fails
When it ends
Then the demo visual stays and E-material-library-003 is shown (wording TBD)
```
